title: Nice but pricey
text: Nice but pricey. I want to rate this higher, but it isn’t quite big enough for the couch. Also it took a day or two for the dogs to have a hole in it even though it’s pet resistant. I have the washable rating a 3 because it isn’t hard to wash, however ours is so big that it doesn’t wash/dry easily in our oversized washer and dryer. As far as it staying tucked in that is about impossible too. It may honestly be because it isn’t quite big enough, but as soon as we sit down it pops the little foam pieces out. Beyond that it has over all served the purpose we got it for and we do honestly get a lot of compliments on it!
